sources.snippet: Gemma 3 270M: Google's Tiniest AI That Runs in 125MB Ultra-compact 270M parameter model designed for edge devices. Runs on phones, IoT devices, and Raspberry Pi with 125MB RAM (INT4). 51.2% IFEval score, trained on 6T tokens, 0.75% battery usage per 25 conversations. Purpose-built for task-specific fine-tuning.

sources.title: Google Launches Gemma 3 270M, Its Smallest and Most Efficient AI Model
sources.snippet: Google has expanded its Gemma family of open AI models with the release of Gemma 3 270M, a lightweight, hyper-efficient system designed for task-specific AI. With just 270 million parameters, the model is the smallest in the Gemma 3 lineup but aims to deliver outsized performance in energy efficiency, fine-tuning speed, and deployment flexibility.
